about: The introitus of the formulary “Saint Anne, Mother of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor blessed Anne, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God. My heart has poured forth a noble word; I recite my works to the King. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor blessed Anne, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God.
